reasons: The two answers are almost the same. Both correct the 60-day and approval premises at the start, give a 解除劳动合同通知书 rather than an application, and get the right numbers: 11月25日 (周三) as the last working day, 329 days → 4 days, 551.72 yuan per day, and an extra 200% = 4,413.79 yuan. I recomputed each of these and all are right. Neither mentions the Shanghai/Jiangsu exception or 劳办发〔1995〕324号. A is a little more precise. It cites 第二十五条 for the penalty limit and 第十八条 for the calendar year, shows the month-by-month day count, links the 民法典 and 12333 sources, and quotes the contract clause word for word in the letter. B has small accuracy slips: '同一条第二十六条' and a paraphrased quote of the contract. It also pre-fills an assumed 2024 start date. Both are somewhat long for the task.
